Two Ways to Partner

Why Coffee Shops Love Us

6 Reasons to Carry Apple Pup Cup

1

Build Customer Loyalty

Dog owners remember the shops that welcome their pups. A simple apple treat creates a ritual that brings them back — every single morning.

2

Social Media Gold

Dogs + treats = content your customers create for you. Pup Cup moments drive organic posts, tags, and word-of-mouth that no ad budget can match.

3

Better Than Whipped Cream

Most pup cups are just a squirt of whipped cream. Apple Pup Cup is a real treat — wholesome, intentional, and made with ingredients you can proudly stand behind.

4

Support a Mission

Every Apple Pup Cup supports Kyler Family Farm Rescue & Therapy — a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to animal rescue. Your customers will love being part of the story.

5

Zero Prep Required

Our ready-to-serve Finished Goods line means no mixing, no baking, no mess. Just open and serve — it's as easy as pulling a pastry from the case.

6

Flexible Product Options

Choose ready-to-serve individual cups for your counter, or stock our DIY Batch Kits as a unique retail item your customers can take home.
